description: Anime4K upscaling, restore and de-ring shaders, vendored verbatim and read by src-tauri/src/inference/anime4k.rs.
notes: The shader files carry the Anime4K licence header themselves; they are not modified.
Only the mpv pass format directives these files use are understood: //!DESC, //!HOOK, //!BIND, //!SAVE, //!WIDTH, //!HEIGHT, //!COMPONENTS and //!WHEN.

Passes are split the way mpv splits them, and mpv stages them: every pass hooking MAIN runs before every pass hooking PREKERNEL, whatever order the files are listed in. The de-ring clamp depends on that ordering.

The reference port in docs/mihon_img_upscale-master/app/src/main/cpp/anime4k.cpp compiles a whole shader file as one pass, which cannot work for a multi-pass Anime4K file; it also never resolves the HOOKED alias or the PREKERNEL hook.
